purpose: Teach: 暴言/往来/斉唱/流星/昇る/追っかけ/エコー/ライティング

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員に対する、本気で、絶対、暴言、絶対、絶対、許さないぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I will not tolerate abusive language toward our staff. Not in any circumstance. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Clipped, measured delivery. Each phrase cut clean and final. Weight on the negation. Voice steady and low — not shouting, but unmistakably serious. The tone of someone who has seen this happen before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。店舗前の、本気で、絶対、往来、絶対、増えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Foot traffic in front of the store has been increasing steadily. We're grateful for the momentum.
lines.style: Straightforward, attentive tone. Reporting facts with quiet pride. Tempo even and respectful. Slight lift at the end — acknowledging the positive trend without overstating it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社歌の、本気で、絶対、斉唱、絶対、社員総会で、絶対、行え、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want the company song sung together at the staff meeting. Make sure it happens.
lines.style: Direct command delivered without ceremony. Expectant pause after the instruction — the kind that assumes compliance. Calm but non-negotiable. A reminder of tradition and unity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品、本気で、絶対、流星、絶対、群キャンペーン、絶対、好評です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The new meteor-shower campaign is performing well. We're grateful for the response from customers.
lines.style: Professional update with understated confidence. Measured pace. The words flow as if from prepared notes, but delivered with genuine warmth. Pride beneath the composure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の業績、本気で、絶対、昇る、絶対、勢いを、絶対、保て、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Our company's performance is rising. Maintain that momentum. Don't let it slip.
lines.style: Firm, deliberate pacing. Each sentence stands alone. Voice carries an edge — not anger, but the weight of expectation. The final instruction lands as a caution and a trust.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社CMの、本気で、絶対、追っかけ、絶対、ファン、絶対、ついておられます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our commercial has attracted dedicated followers. The audience loyalty is growing stronger.
lines.style: Calm report of good news. Slight emphasis on the word followers — recognizing achievement. Steady tempo, professional but with a thread of quiet satisfaction running underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界での、本気で、絶対、エコー、絶対、効果、絶対、当社、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Watch closely how our company is being talked about in the industry. That echo matters.
lines.style: Thoughtful and deliberate. A slight pedagogical tone — not lecturing, but pointing out what matters. Tempo unhurried. The voice of someone who reads industry signals and expects his team to develop the same instinct.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、広報、絶対、ライティング、絶対、専門スタッフ、絶対、配置しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've placed specialized staff in our public relations and media team. We're grateful for their expertise.
lines.style: Confident closing statement. Professional pride evident but not forced. The rhythm suggests finality — a summary of preparedness. Warm undertone, the tone of someone concluding a briefing well.
